Last updated: 17 July 2026

Cumbuco Rentals respects your privacy. This notice explains what information is handled when you use cumbuco.net or contact us about a rental.

Information you choose to provide

When you use our secure website form, you provide your name, email address, travel dates, number of guests, preferred property, and any details you include in your message. The enquiry is protected with Cloudflare Turnstile, sent through Cloudflare Email Sending, and delivered to our designated enquiry mailbox so we can reply to you.

If you choose WhatsApp instead, the enquiry details are placed into a WhatsApp message only after you select that option. Your message is then handled under WhatsApp’s own privacy terms as well as our internal booking process.

We use enquiry and reservation information to answer your request, check availability, prepare a quotation, arrange a stay, provide requested services, keep necessary booking and accounting records, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell your personal information.

Website and availability data

The website is delivered through Cloudflare. Like most hosting and security providers, Cloudflare may process technical request information such as IP addresses, browser details, requested pages, timestamps, and security signals to deliver, protect, and operate the service.

Property availability is synchronized server-side with private Google Calendar feeds. Visitors receive reserved-date information only; calendar event titles, guest names, and other private event details are not displayed by the website.

Cookies and analytics

At the date shown above, cumbuco.net does not use Google Analytics, advertising trackers, user accounts, login cookies, or booking-management cookies. The website does not set optional analytics or advertising cookies. Basic technical processing by Cloudflare may still occur to deliver, secure, and protect the website and its enquiry form.

If we later introduce analytics, advertising, or other optional cookie-based services, we will update this notice and add any consent controls required before those services are enabled.

Sharing and retention

We share personal information only when needed to respond to an enquiry, arrange or administer a reservation, work with the relevant property owner or service provider, operate the website and communications, comply with law, or protect legitimate rights and security. Service providers may process information in other countries under their own safeguards and applicable terms.

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably needed for the enquiry or reservation, legal and accounting requirements, dispute resolution, and security. Retention periods can vary according to the nature of the communication or booking.

Your rights

Subject to applicable law, including Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), you may ask whether we process your personal data and request access, correction, information about sharing, anonymization, blocking, or deletion where applicable. Some information may need to be retained when required by law or for the exercise of legal rights.

Contact

To ask a privacy question or exercise a data-protection right, contact Cumbuco Rentals by telephone or WhatsApp at +55 85 98813 9402. We will update this page when our data practices materially change.
